FOOD is NOT cumulative — each recycle your people eat your current tier's coins.
ASCEND coins are taken once, the first time you reach that tier. CAP is the highest rank you may buy.
1 per cashed card · research, fortify, attacks, food
units on map + centre rank of your victory row + 3 per terrain majority
gold breaks ties · fewer than 3 cards in the row score 1 each
The row scores the card in the CENTRE slot, so fill it — and mind what lands in the middle.
— slide cards in from below, ranks ascending left to right; the centre slot scores
